_readme: Regions inside a country (prefectures, oblasts, counties…). Each entry becomes a section under its parent in the skill tree, a quiz area and a map layer. Add one, run `NE_DIR=… node scripts/build-shapes.mjs` (shapes) and `npm run sync` (facts). source.type: 'ne-admin1' = Natural Earth 1:10m states/provinces (any country, by ISO A3); 'us-counties' = US Census counties (us-atlas), by state FIPS code. groups[].match lists Natural Earth 'region' values ('*' = everything left over).
